title: Port DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO, RDPG to BaseAgentAlgorithm with literature-conformant updates, add comparison policies
plan_items: 1.4 (actor tanh, noise only in select_action, normalised actions)
1.5 (remove TD3/PPO failstack, action shrinking, reward multiplier, PPO risk_tolerance, learning_starts)
purpose: Each algorithm becomes a BaseAgentAlgorithm subclass operating only in the normalised spaces defined by rl_core. The six work packages touch disjoint files and can be implemented by six independent workers.
common_requirements: Uses rl_core ReplayBuffer or RolloutBuffer. Local ReplayBuffer classes in the file are deleted (A10).
Uses networks.py (or sac_networks.py for SAC). Must not import actor_critic.py, agent_algorithm.py, algorithm_utils.py or any module global hyperparameter.
select_action returns action_dim values. No try/except that returns a default action (A1). Exceptions propagate.
No failstack counter, no action shrinking, no reward multiplier, no risk tolerance inside the algorithm (C7).
No gradient update before len(buffer) >= config.learning_starts (B7). update() performs config.gradient_steps updates.
All tensors float32 on device.get_device(). Uses torch.optim.Adam. Optional gradient clipping with torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ when max_grad_norm is set.
update() returns UpdateStats with critic_loss, actor_loss (None on steps without actor update), mean_q.
Google-style docstrings citing the equation numbers of the reference paper.

work_packages.class: DDPGAlgorithm(BaseAgentAlgorithm), config_class = DDPGConfig, is_learning = True, is_on_policy = False
update_rule: y = r + gamma * (1 - terminated) * Q'(s', mu'(s')), target actor without noise (C3).
Critic loss: mean squared error between Q(s, a) and y, a from the buffer (normalised, C5).
Actor loss: -mean Q(s, mu(s)).
Soft target update with tau after each gradient step.
work_packages.exploration: u = clip(mu(o) + N(0, sigma^2 I), -1, 1) only when explore is True. sigma decays once per period in end_period.
tests: contract
target computation uses actor_target without noise (monkeypatch rng, compare)
critic loss decreases on a fixed synthetic batch with constant reward
actor gradient non-zero

work_packages.reference: Fujimoto et al. (2018), Algorithm 1 and eq. 14-15
update_rule: Target action: a' = clip(mu'(s') + clip(eps, -c, c), -1, 1), eps ~ N(0, policy_noise^2), c = noise_clip, in normalised space (C5).
y = r + gamma * (1 - terminated) * min(Q1'(s', a'), Q2'(s', a')).
Both critics regress to y.
Actor and target networks updated every policy_delay critic updates, actor loss -mean Q1(s, mu(s)).
Remove update_failstack, get_failstack_adjustment and the (1 - failstack) reward multiplier.
work_packages.exploration: Gaussian N(0, exploration_sigma^2) in normalised space, clipped to [-1, 1].
tests: contract
target actions lie in [-1, 1] and differ from actor_target output by at most noise_clip
actor updated only every policy_delay steps (parameter snapshot)
multi-plant action_dim = 3 output shape (A1)

work_packages.reference: Haarnoja et al. (2018), eq. 5-7, 11-13, appendix C (tanh correction), automatic temperature per Haarnoja et al. (2018b) 'Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms and Applications'
update_rule: Policy outputs u = tanh(z), z ~ N(mu(s), sigma(s)), log pi includes the tanh Jacobian correction.
Remove _scale_action to prices: the policy, buffer and critics work with u in [-1, 1].
Twin soft Q critics, target y = r + gamma * (1 - terminated) * (min Q'(s', u') - alpha * log pi(u'|s')).
Temperature loss with target_entropy = -action_dim when None.
Training only after learning_starts (already present, aligned to config).
work_packages.exploration: explore=True samples from the policy. explore=False returns tanh(mu(s)). exploration_scale returns alpha.
tests: contract
log-prob correction matches numerical density of the squashed Gaussian on a grid (1-D)
deterministic output in eval mode
alpha updates toward target entropy sign

work_packages.reference: Schulman et al. (2017) clipped surrogate eq. 7, Schulman et al. (2016) GAE eq. 16
update_rule: Policy: tanh-squashed diagonal Gaussian with state-independent log std (initial_log_std). log pi(u|s) = log N(z; mu, sigma) - sum log(1 - tanh(z)^2), computed with the numerically stable form 2 * (log 2 - z - softplus(-2 z)).
select_action(explore=True) samples z, returns ActionResult(u=tanh(z), log_prob, value=V(s), pre_squash=z). The behaviour log-probability is stored at sampling time (C6).
evaluate(s, z) recomputes log pi of the stored pre-squash sample with the current parameters, the same distribution family as sampling (C6).

Update when the RolloutBuffer holds rollout_length transitions and len >= learning_starts: compute GAE with last value V(next_obs of the last transition), normalise advantages, run 'epochs' passes over shuffled minibatches.

Policy loss: -mean over NON-intervened steps of min(ratio * A, clip(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * A), ratio = exp(logp_new - logp_old). Value loss: mean over ALL steps of (V(s) - return)^2 times value_coef. Optional entropy bonus estimated by -logp_new (entropy_coef default 0).
Intervened steps (fail-stack replaced the price): Transition.intervened True, excluded from the policy loss, kept in the value loss and GAE.
Remove risk_tolerance, update_failstack, get_failstack_adjustment, the reward multiplier, and the noise/decay parameters of the old PolicyNetwork.
Clear the rollout buffer after each update.
work_packages.exploration: Stochastic policy. explore=False returns tanh(mu(s)). exploration_scale returns mean sigma.
tests: contract (adapted: update happens at rollout_length)
ratio == 1 for every sample in the first minibatch of the first epoch
stored behaviour log-prob equals evaluate() before any update
intervened steps contribute zero policy gradient (gradient check with all-intervened batch)
GAE against hand computation

work_packages.reference: Heess et al. (2015), 'Memory-based control with recurrent neural networks', Algorithm 1
update_rule: Training samples windows of seq_len consecutive transitions with ReplayBuffer.sample_sequences. Recurrent actor and critic start from a zero hidden state for every window (B3).

Critic: Q(h_k, a_k) for every step k of the window with the actually taken action a_k (B3). Target y_k = r_k + gamma * (1 - terminated_k) * Q'(h_{k+1}, mu'(h_{k+1})), computed by running the target networks over the window extended by the final next_obs.
Actor loss: -mean over steps of Q(h_k, mu(h_k)).
Soft target updates with tau.
work_packages.acting_history: One deque of the last seq_len observations passed to select_action. These are the same normalised observations that the runtime stores in transitions, so acting and learning use identically constructed sequences (PLAN 1.6: no second, differently built history). The acting pass also starts from a zero hidden state over the window. With fewer than seq_len observations the window is shorter (no zero padding with fake values).
work_packages.exploration: Gaussian N(0, exploration_sigma^2) on the last-step output, clipped to [-1, 1].
tests: contract
critic receives per-step actions (changing a_k changes Q only at steps >= k)
acting is deterministic with explore=False for the same observation history
window never mixes observations from two different construction paths (history equals last seq_len observations given to select_action)

rules: RANDOM: u ~ U[-1, 1]^action_dim from the agent generator, independent of explore.

MARGINAL_COST: price_i = plant_variable_costs[i] (fuelCost, USD/MWh), clipped to [price_low, price_high], returned as u via the affine map of action_space (local pure implementation to avoid importing services.agent).
FIXED_MARKUP: price_i = (plant_variable_costs[i] + plant_static_costs[i]) * (1 + markup), default markup 0.10 (OQ-6), clipped to [price_low, price_high], mapped to u.
observe/update are no-ops, update returns None, exploration_scale returns None, fail-stack never applies (runtime_core checks is_learning).
tests: contract (non-learning variant)
MARGINAL_COST price equals variable cost after to_price round trip within one price quantum
cost above price_high clips to +1
RANDOM reproducible with the same seed

invariants: No file in this spec reads or writes the database.
With a fixed rng seed and torch.manual_seed, two instances produce identical action sequences on CPU.

Very small learning_starts equal to batch_size.

SAC/PPO: |z| large (tanh saturation) does not produce NaN or Inf log-probabilities.
